list.name: satellite
list.label: Satellite
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT satellite FROM tenant_telemetry ORDER BY 1

list.name: field
list.label: Field
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT field FROM tenant_telemetry WHERE satellite = '$satellite' ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN length(field) > 40 THEN regexp_replace(field, '^.*_([^_]+_[^_]+_[^_]+_[^_]+)$', '\1') ELSE field END AS metric, value_num AS value FROM tenant_telemetry WHERE satellite = '$satellite' AND field IN ($field) AND value_num IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT satellite, field, count(*) AS points, max(ts) AS last_seen FROM tenant_telemetry GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
